exactToolArguments.prompt:
Create FOUR NEW ORIGINAL ASHVEIL inventory item icons in one square transparent atlas, exactly TWO ROWS x TWO COLUMNS. The first attached OWN image is our3-legged Surveyor machine: match its worn grey alloy panels, restrained tarnished bronze pivot rims and very dark optical glass, but draw ONLY recovered separate materials, NOT a complete machine. The other attached OWN32px industrial items indicate muted material colours and readable inventory silhouettes only; do not copy or enlarge their pixels. These are wholly new original industrial salvage object illustrations, rich restrained pixel-style dark fantasy rendering, fixed slightly elevated3/4 object view. They must be distinct at32x32, not generic identical brown scrap piles.

TOP LEFT = SURVEY LENS: one intact high-value round optical lens assembly removed from the Surveyor head. A short grey alloy circular retaining barrel with TWO nested rings, a few small recessed screw notches and a thin tarnished bronze lip; a large clearly curved very dark blue-grey glass disk with a small cool reflected arc/glint. Clearly optical glass held in a mechanical ring, not a human eyeball, crystal ball, coin, watch, blank washer, telescope, full camera head or glowing blue magic. No powered light source. Complete ring/glass/body all included, no detached tiny debris.

TOP RIGHT = ANTENNA WIRE: one coherent small loose COIL OF COPPER WIRE, approximately5to6 visible overlapping wire loops around an open centre with TWO readable trailing bent ends attached to the same coil. Exposed reddish/orange copper surface with muted brown oxidation and a few very restrained greenish tarnish patches; thin metallic circular wire, not chunky gold rings, rope, chain, black cable, antenna pole, plug, spool or yellow plastic insulation. The warm copper coil silhouette and two ends must read clearly at32px. No detached pieces.

BOTTOM LEFT = LIGHT LEG FRAME: ONE removed articulated lightweight ALLOY LEG ASSEMBLY matching the reference's tripod leg construction. Tall narrow1:2 silhouette, slightly bent at one round knee pivot: upper hollow grey alloy rail with triangular cutouts, lower slimmer strut and small flat circular/oval foot flange at the end; two restrained bronze-grey mechanical hinge caps, a very short attached dark cable. Worn silvery-grey metal with subtle oxidation/chipped edges, NOT bright shiny chrome, huge orange iron rust or wood. Clearly one coherent lightweight machine leg frame, not a human/bird leg, animal bone, gun, whole robot, arm/hand, pair of legs, three-legged tripod stand, detached separate screws or general scrap pile. Complete upper mounting point and foot flange inside icon. Make this icon vertical/tall for an item occupying1inventory column by2rows, but still legible in a32px square thumbnail.

BOTTOM RIGHT = THERMAL SENSOR COMPONENT: ONE small rectangular industrial infrared sensing module, distinct from the round lens. A compact dark grey alloy/ceramic module with a clearly recessed black RECTANGULAR IR sensor window and a few small copper/gold contact tabs along one lower edge; subtle small vent ribs on the side and a couple of old screw bosses. A salvaged unpowered physical sensor, not an entire camera/robot head, ordinary battery/power cell, smartphone, screen/colored heat-map, rectangular glowing eye, magic gem, fire, thermometer drawing or coin. Black ceramic/glass surface with one restrained grey reflected highlight; NO self-illumination. Maintain muted Surveyor material style and a recognisable rectangular silhouette at32px.

CRITICAL COMPOSITION: all4objects separate independent complete isolated icons. Each is centred in its own quadrant and occupies AT MOST55percent cell width and55percent cell height; keep huge truly alpha-zero transparent gutters between each icon and every atlas edge. Lens/wire/sensor have broadly balanced square inventory silhouettes; leg is a tall narrow icon with generous lateral room. No clipping, no touching/overlap, no foreign object/fragment in another quadrant. Do not add loose debris, ground/soil/shadow discs, plates beneath the objects, hands, money, UI borders, labels, numbers, text, logos, grid/checkerboard, glow or backdrop. ONLY these four fully included physical items, original pixels on transparent PNG. No commercial-game pixels, copying or tracing.
